sections.shortTitle: Representation of the People Third Amendment Ordinance 1996
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE CVII OF 1996
ORDINANCE CVII OF 1996
REPRESENTATION OF THE PEOPLE (THIRD AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance further to amend the
Representation of the People Act, 1976
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
2nd November, 1996]
No.F.2(1)/96‑Pub., dated 2‑11‑1996.‑‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further to amend the
Representation of the People Act, 1976 (LXXXV of 1976), for the purposes
hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly is not in
session and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which render it
necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers
conferred by clause (1) of Article $9 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:‑‑
1. Short title and commencement.‑‑‑(1) This
Ordinance may be called the Representation of the People (Third Amendment)
Ordinance, 1996.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

sections.description:
Amendment of section 12, AM LXXXV of 1976

ORDINANCE CVII OF 1996
ORDINANCE CVII OF 1996
REPRESENTATION OF THE PEOPLE (THIRD AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance further to amend the
Representation of the People Act, 1976
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
2nd November, 1996]
No.F.2(1)/96‑Pub., dated 2‑11‑1996.‑‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further to amend the
Representation of the People Act, 1976 (LXXXV of 1976), for the purposes
hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly is not in
session and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which render it
necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers
conferred by clause (1) of Article $9 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:‑‑
2. Amendment of section 12, AM LXXXV of 1976.‑‑‑In the
Representation of the People Act, 1976 (LXXXV of 1976), hereinafter referred to
as the said Act, in section 12‑‑‑
(1) for subsection (2) the following shall be
substituted, namely:
"(2) Every nomination shall be made by a
separate nomination paper in the prescribed form which shall be signed by both
the proposer and the seconder and shall contain, duly signed by the candidate,‑‑
(i) a declaration that he has consented to the
nomination and that he is not subject to any disqualification for being elected
as a member;
(ii) a declaration about his party affiliation,
if any;
(iii) a declaration that an amount, of loan, as
may be prescribed, obtained from any bank, financial institution, cooperative
society or corporate body in his own name or in the name of his spouse or
dependent children or dependent parents or any business concern mainly owned by
the aforesaid, does not remain unpaid for more than one year from the due date;
(iv) a declaration that no loan, the amount of
which may be prescribed, obtained by him, his spouse or dependent children or
dependent parents or a business concern mainly owned by him or anyone of the
aforesaid from any bank, financial institution, cooperative society or
corporate body was written off or such amount which was written off has since
been paid;
(v) a declaration that he, his spouse or
dependent children or dependent parents or a business concern mainly owned or
having any share in such business concern have not made any default in payment
of taxes for over six months of an amount as may be prescribed; and
(vi) a declaration that he, his spouse or
dependent children or dependent parents or a business concern mainly owned or
having any share in such business have not made default in payment of utility
expenses, including telephone, electricity, gas and water charges, for over six
months of an amount 4s may be prescribed; and
(2) after subsection (7), the following
Explanation shall be added, namely:‑‑
"Explanation.‑‑For the
purposes of this section, the expression‑‑‑
(a) "loans, advances or credits"
shall mean the loans, advances and credits written off after the 23rd day of
March, 1985;
(b) "mainly owned" shall mean
ownership of ten per cent. or more shares in a business concern; and
(c) "taxes" includes all taxes levied
by Federal, Provincial or local authorities. ".

ORDINANCE CVII OF 1996
ORDINANCE CVII OF 1996
REPRESENTATION OF THE PEOPLE (THIRD AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance further to amend the
Representation of the People Act, 1976
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
2nd November, 1996]
No.F.2(1)/96‑Pub., dated 2‑11‑1996.‑‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further to amend the
Representation of the People Act, 1976 (LXXXV of 1976), for the purposes
hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly is not in
session and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which render it
necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers
conferred by clause (1) of Article $9 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:‑‑
4. Insertion of new sections 42A and 42B, Act
LXXXV of 1976.‑‑In
the said Act, after section 42, amended as aforesaid, the following new
sections shall be inserted, namely:‑‑
"42A. Inspection of statement of assets
and liabilities etc.‑‑(1) A candidate may, on an application made
to the Commissioner and on payment of such fee as may be prescribed, be allowed
to inspect the statement of assets and liabilities of a returned candidate
submitted under subsection (3A) of section 42.
(2) Copies of the statement of assets and
liabilities submitted by a returned candidate under subsection (3A) of section
42 or section 42B may cause to be supplied to any candidate, including a
candidate contesting any future election, within fifteen days from making of an
application for supply of copy in the manner and on payment of such fee as may
be prescribed.
42B. Yearly submission of statements of assets
and liabilities.‑‑In addition to statement of assets and
liabilities submitted under subsection (3A) of section 42, every member shall,
on a prescribed form, submit a statement of assets and liabilities annually to
the Commissioner within one month from the end of each financial year.

ORDINANCE CVII OF 1996
ORDINANCE CVII OF 1996

ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance further to amend the
Representation of the People Act, 1976
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
2nd November, 1996]
No.F.2(1)/96‑Pub., dated 2‑11‑1996.‑‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further to amend the
Representation of the People Act, 1976 (LXXXV of 1976), for the purposes
hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly is not in
session and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which render it
necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers
conferred by clause (1) of Article $9 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:‑‑
5. Insertion of new sections 48, 49, 50 and 51,
Act LXXXV of 1976.‑‑ In
the said Act, after section 47‑A, in Chapter VI, the following new
sections shall be inserted, namely:‑‑
"48. Definition. ‑‑‑In
this Chapter, 'election expenses' means any expenditure incurred before, during
and after an election or payment made, whether by way of gift, loan, advance,
deposit or otherwise, for the arrangement, conduct or benefit of, or in
connection with or incidental to, the election of a candidate, including the
expenditure on account of issuing circulars of publications otherwise
presenting to the electors the candidate or his views, aims or objects but does
not include the deposit made under section 13.
49. Restriction on election expenses.‑‑‑(1)
No person shall, except as provided in subsection (2), make any payment
whatsoever towards the election expenses of a candidate except to such
candidate.
(2) No person other than the candidate shall
incur any election expenses of such candidate:
Provided that any person may, if so authorised
by a contesting candidate in writing specifying a maximum amount, to the extent
of such amount make payment for stationery, postage, telegram and other petty
expenses.
(3) The election expenses of a contesting
candidate shall not exceed, in the case of an election to a seat in the
National Assembly, one million rupees and, in the case of an election to a seat
in a Provincial Assembly, six hundred thousand rupees.
(4) Any person incurring any expenditure or
making any payment under subsection (2) shall, within fourteen days of the
declaration of the result of the election, send to the candidate a statement of
such expenditure or the particulars of such payment.
(5) A candidate shall, by a bill stating the
particulars and by a receipt, vouch for every payment made in respect of
election expenses except where the amount is less than five hundred rupees.
50. Return of election expenses.‑‑‑(1)
Every contesting candidate shall within thirty days after the publication of
the name of the returned candidate, submit to the Returning Officer a return of
election expenses in the prescribed form containing‑‑
(a) a statement of all payments made by the
contesting candidate together with all the bills and receipts;
(b) a statement of all disputed claims of which
the contesting candidate is aware,
(c) a statement of all unpaid claims, if any,
of which the contesting candidate is aware; and
(d) a statement of all moneys, securities or
equivalent of money received from any person for the purpose of election
expenses specifying the name of every such person,
(2) The return submitted under subsection (1)
shall be accompanied by an affidavit in the prescribed form sworn by the
contesting candidate.
51. Inspection of returns, etc. ‑‑‑(1)
The return and documents submitted under section 50 shall be kept by the
Returning Officer in his office or at such other convenient place as he may
think fit and shall, during one year from the date of their receipt by him, be
open to inspection by any pers

namely:‑‑
"102. Removal and remission of
disqualification.‑‑‑The Commissioner may, on an application
made in this behalf,‑‑
(a) remit any disqualification for failure to
submit the return of election expenses or for any error or incorrect statement
in such return; and
(b) condone any mistake or omission in any
statement or declaration,
if the Commissioner is satisfied that such
failure, error, omission or mistake had occurred or incorrect statement was
made bona fide or due to circumstances beyond the control of the applicant.

ORDINANCE CVII OF 1996
ORDINANCE CVII OF 1996
REPRESENTATION OF THE PEOPLE (THIRD AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance further to amend the
Representation of the People Act, 1976
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
2nd November, 1996]
No.F.2(1)/96‑Pub., dated 2‑11‑1996.‑‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further to amend the
Representation of the People Act, 1976 (LXXXV of 1976), for the purposes
hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly is not in
session and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which render it
necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers
conferred by clause (1) of Article $9 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:‑‑
14. Repeal.‑‑The Representation of the People
(Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1996 (LXXVI of 1996) is hereby repealed.
